@@ -367,6 +367,38 @@ void V8InspectorImpl::idleStarted() { m_isolate->SetIdle(true); }
 
 void V8InspectorImpl::idleFinished() { m_isolate->SetIdle(false); }
 
+void V8InspectorImpl::consoleAPICalled(
+    v8::Local<v8::Context> context, v8::Isolate::MessageErrorLevel level,
+    const std::vector<v8::Local<v8::Value>>& arguments,
+    StringView consoleContext) {
+  int groupId = contextGroupId(context);
+  if (!groupId) return;
+  ConsoleAPIType type = ConsoleAPIType::kLog;
+  switch (level) {
+    case v8::Isolate::kMessageDebug:
+      type = ConsoleAPIType::kDebug;
+      break;
+    case v8::Isolate::kMessageInfo:
+      type = ConsoleAPIType::kInfo;
+      break;
+    case v8::Isolate::kMessageError:
+      type = ConsoleAPIType::kError;
+      break;
+    case v8::Isolate::kMessageWarning:
+      type = ConsoleAPIType::kWarning;
+      break;
+    case v8::Isolate::kMessageLog:
+    case v8::Isolate::kMessageAll:
+      break;
+  }
+  std::unique_ptr<V8ConsoleMessage> consoleMessage =
+      V8ConsoleMessage::createForConsoleAPI(
+          context, InspectedContext::contextId(context), groupId, this,
+          m_client->currentTimeMS(), type, arguments,
+          toString16(consoleContext), m_debugger->captureStackTrace(true));
+  ensureConsoleMessageStorage(groupId)->addMessage(std::move(consoleMessage));
+}
+

     v8::Local<v8::Context> context, StringView message,
     v8::Local<v8::Value> exception, StringView detailedMessage, StringView url,
